name: approve
intent: Record a staff member's decision and suggestion for a repair request in its approval history.
A Staff member records an approval decision for a Repair
pre: The repair identified by rid exists.
The staff member identified by sid exists.
post: A new approval-history entry is created.
The entry records the supplied reject value.
The entry records the supplied suggestion.
The entry is stored among approval-history records.
The entry is added to the repair's history.
The repair remains stored in the system.
The operation returns the new history entry.
difficulty_basis: Workflow branch meaning is unresolved; the scaffold's Hard label is not promoted to a final assessment.
missing: Original RM2PT approval specification or confirmed reference resolving whether reject=true advances approval or rejects it, including role/stage transitions.
Original specification must also clarify evaluation timing of Process guards versus Process assignments; current reference uses unqualified Process in both condition and effect.
conflicts: Existing description advances when not rejected; local OCL and Jest advance when reject=true and set stage 5 when reject=false. Neither polarity is silently selected as the restored requirement.
scenarios: History assertions match known obligations; role-1 stage advancement is unresolved against the original description.
Both parameterized role/stage cases agree with local OCL but conflict with the description's reject polarity; stage obligations withheld.
Records false and asserts stage 5; the latter is unresolved, not called requirement-correct.
description_audit: KEEP + NORMALIZE common history semantics only; preserve the disputed workflow prose in description_original.
reference_audit: Candidate reference located but not accepted as ground truth because branch meaning conflicts with the preserved description.
effects_audit: Known creation, history insertion, field initialization and result restored. Conditional process effects explicitly unresolved rather than omitted silently.

name: finishRepair
intent: Mark the identified device repair as finished by its responsible worker.
A Staff member marks a Repair as finished for a specific Device
pre: The device identified by did is assigned to the staff member identified by sid.
The staff member has worker role value 3.
post: The repair identified by id is placed in finished process state 7.
difficulty_basis: The result-text effect is unresolved; do not finalize complexity from the operation name.
missing: Confirm whether res must be written to Repair.Result: this attribute exists in the local entity model, but neither the encoded postcondition nor the Jest assertions assigns/checks it. Also supply original behavior when the identified repair/device/staff is absent. Attribute existence alone does not establish an assignment obligation.

review_findings.assessment: The local model does contain Repair.Result. The remaining gap is behavioral evidence for assigning res to that attribute, not absence of a possible storage field. The original description/reference conflict is still unresolved.

evidence.quote:
name: 'Result',
        type: 'String',
        description: 'Final result or outcome of the repair'

conflicts: Description says the result text is recorded; local postcondition changes only Process and result, and Jest never asserts storage of res.
scenarios: Checks state 7 and true; does not establish result-text persistence.
description_audit: KEEP + NORMALIZE established state change; record the result-text phrase as unresolved, not as an invented field update.
reference_audit: Local candidate preserved by pointer but not installed as reliable ground truth pending description/effect reconciliation.
effects_audit: Process update and Boolean result covered. No assignment from res or additional state guard inferred.

name: feedback
intent: Record a repair requester's score and feedback for a finished repair.
The Staff who raised a Repair provides a Score
pre: The staff member identified by sid is the person who raised the repair identified by id.
The staff member has ground-staff role value 0.
The repair is in finished process state 7.
post: The repair records the supplied score.
If the score is at least 3, the repair is marked closed.
If the score is below 3, the repair is marked not closed.
If the score is below 3, the repair description becomes the supplied des text.
If the score is below 3, the repair returns to process state 0.
The repair remains stored in the system.
difficulty_basis: Three guards and branch-specific score, closure, description and workflow-state effects.
scenarios: Threshold score 3 closes repair and returns true.
description_audit: KEEP + NORMALIZE. Replace vague high-enough threshold with the explicitly evidenced value 3; preserve conditional low-score description update.
reference_audit: Local OCL and both positive branches support the detailed threshold. No score range guard is inferred from model prose.
effects_audit: Score, closure branches, low-score description, state reset, retained record and return covered. No high-score description change added.
